annotations.title: Set company login for a team

description: Company login for a team (Team plan, owners only): anyone who signs in with a verified address on this email domain (Google, Microsoft or email link) joins the team automatically. The owner must be signed in with a verified address on that domain. domain='off' stops it. get_team_settings reads the current setting.
name: set_team_domain
title: Set company login for a team
